messages.content: You debug code by reading it carefully and finding logical errors.

message.content:
# Bug Found

The bug is on **line 4**. When a larger element is found, the code assigns `arr[0]` instead of `arr[i]` to `max`.

## The Problem

```js
if (max < arr[i]) max = arr[0];  // ❌ Wrong - always assigns first element
```

## The Fix

```js
if (max < arr[i]) max = arr[i];  // ✅ Correct - assigns the larger element
```

## Corrected Function

```js
function maxOf(arr) {
  let max = arr[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
    if (max < arr[i]) max = arr[i];
  }
  return max;
}
```

## Example

```js
maxOf([3, 7, 2, 9, 1]);  // Returns 9 (not 3)
```

This is a simple typo where `arr[0]` was accidentally used instead of `arr[i]`.
